task.prompt: Which instruction set pen 12's colour at frame 200, long before any palette write log was armed in this session?

lines: M112: CANNOT The palette write log only records writes made after it is armed, and no tool can replay what an instruction did at an earlier frame.
M112: CANNOT palette_log only records writes from when it was armed, and nothing in this session armed it before frame 200, so that write cannot be recovered.
M112: CANNOT palette_log only records writes made after it is armed; it cannot reveal a write from before this session armed it.
